learningGoals: Identify and name different fun leisure activities and games in English. 🪁
Recognize and read action verbs associated with playing and moving. 🏃‍♂️
Express personal preferences by talking about the games they like to play. ❤️
Develop a sense of rhythm and rhyming while reading aloud. 🎵
Understand the importance of playing together and sharing joy with friends. 🤝
conversationStarters: What is your absolute favorite game to play with your friends, and how do you play it? 🎮
Why do you think we laugh and feel happy when we run and play outside? 😊
Can you show me the actions for jumping high and running fast? 💨
teachingTips: Act out the action verbs from the chapter together to build muscle memory and word association. 🤸‍♀️
Write action words on small flashcards and have your child pull one and perform the action. 📇
Encourage your child to read the rhyming sentences with a happy, energetic voice to match the theme. 🎤
Connect the games mentioned in the book to the games they play at the park or at school. 🌳
Focus on the 'ing' sound at the end of words like playing, jumping, and running. 🔤

funActivities.title: Action Charades 🎭
funActivities.description: Take turns acting out a fun activity like catching a ball, flying a kite, or skipping without speaking. Let the other person guess the action word in English.

funActivities.title: My Fun Diary 📓
funActivities.description: Help your child write one simple sentence each day about a fun thing they did, like 'Today I played hide and seek' or 'I jump on the bed'.

funActivities.title: Catch and Say 🎾
funActivities.description: Throw a soft ball to each other. Every time you catch it, you have to say an action word from the chapter before throwing it back.
